Testing / Admin

Temporary page for site testing and administration. No login is required yet.

UI build: 2026-08-03 - RemIcsReWrite feature smoke panel + file-op/TSIP compare

Fixtures: cat / ecomm2602 (rctl smoke), cmxts01 (complex TS ~478 chans), cmxts03 (TSIP), cmxes01 / cmxes02 (complex ES). Master copies in tests/remicsdev/fixtures/files/complex/; live pinned tables in each schema. Restore after destructive tests: Restore-MicsComplexFixtures.ps1.

TS / ES Export, Import, and Validate

Runs the appropriate Ft* or Fe* tools against pinned fixtures from tests/remicsdev/fixtures. Compare layers L1 (process), L2 (structure), L3 (baseline metrics).


        

      

    


    

      
DbUpdate staging pipeline (fwmda)

      

      
Process files from D:\updates\primary through import → validate → MtUpdate/MeUpdate. All batch steps run as fwmda (schema fmda2) for billing attribution. Default mode syncs spoof MDB from main.*, runs spoof (-s), then updates main.* only when spoof succeeds.

Recent distinct TSIP re-run compare

      

      
Captures and re-runs the latest completed archive for up to 10 distinct TSIP files (schema + TS/ES type + parameter file), then compares database archives and reports. Repeated runs of the same file count once. If fewer than 10 exist, all available files run; future distinct files are picked up automatically.
